localImage.name: Local Image
localImage.description: Show an image from the frame's files: one picture, or a folder of them one at a time.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Image filename or folder
fields.hint: In the frame's files: its assets folder (an SD card on an ESP32) or /srv/internal.

fields.name: counterStateKey
fields.label: Optional state key for persistence
fields.hint: Enter a state key to persist the current image index between restarts.

fields.name: metadataStateKey
fields.label: Optional metadata state key
fields.hint: Enter a state key to persist metadata about the last image. Stores: {path, filename, index, total, width, height, exif: {make, model, lensModel, exposureTime, fNumber, iso, focalLength, dateTimeOriginal, gpsLatitude, ...}, exifSummary}. EXIF is parsed from JPEG files; exifSummary is a one-line photographer credit.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Local Image",
  "description": "Show an image from the frame's files: one picture, or a folder of them one at a time.",
  "category": "data",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "permissions": ["files"],
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "path",
      "type": "path",
      "pick": "any",
      "extensions": ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "bmp", "webp", "qoi", "ppm", "svg"],
      "value": "",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Image filename or folder",
      "placeholder": "Defaults to the assets folder (e.g. /srv/assets)",
      "hint": "In the frame's files: its assets folder (an SD card on an ESP32) or /srv/internal."
    },
    {
      "name": "order",
      "type": "select",
      "options": ["random", "alphabetical"],
      "value": "random",
      "required": true,
      "label": "Order of images"
    },
    {
      "name": "counterStateKey",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Optional state key for persistence",
      "hint": "Enter a state key to persist the current image index between restarts."
    },
    {
      "name": "metadataStateKey",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Optional metadata state key",
      "hint": "Enter a state key to persist metadata about the last image. Stores: {path, filename, index, total, width, height, exif: {make, model, lensModel, exposureTime, fNumber, iso, focalLength, dateTimeOriginal, gpsLatitude, ...}, exifSummary}. EXIF is parsed from JPEG files; exifSummary is a one-line photographer credit."
    },
    {
      "name": "search",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Filter filenames by keyword"
    }
  ],
  "output": [
    {
      "name": "image",
      "type": "image"
    }
  ],
  "cache": {
    "enabled": true,
    "inputEnabled": true,
    "durationEnabled": true,
    "duration": "900"
  }
}
